identificationModule.briefTitle: The Effects Of Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE) On Age Related Biomarkers And Epigenetics
identificationModule.officialTitle: A Comparative Randomized Placebo (Sham Pheresis) Controlled Clinical Trial To Evaluate The Effects Of Therapeutic Plasma Exchange (TPE) On Age Related Biomarkers And Epigenetics

descriptionModule.briefSummary: The goal of this clinical trial is to assure the safety of long term therapeutic plasma exchange (TPE) with and without Intravenous Immunoglobulin (IVIG) and its effects on biomarkers and epigenetic biologic clocks in forty individuals. The main question is to assure the safety from long term TPE using changes in clinical and laboratory outcomes and also evaluating changes on additional blood biomarkers and epigenetic clocks during and after TPE treatment. Researchers will compare the TPE treatment group to the Sham treatment group to identify changes due to TPE. Participants will receive six TPE or Sham treatments over one of two treatment schedules and may receive IVIG with treatment.

armGroups.label: TPE Monthly
armGroups.description: will receive 6 monthly TPE procedures (TOTAL 6 treatments)

armGroups.label: TPE Bimonthly
armGroups.description: will receive 2 TPE procedures in one week. The same treatment will be repeated on a monthly basis two more times (Two treatments per month for three months to total 6 treatments)

armGroups.label: TPE Bimonthly with IVIG
armGroups.description: will receive 2 TPE procedures followed by 2 gm of IVIG in one week. The same treatment will be repeated on a monthly basis twice more. (Two TPE procedures per month for three months - total of 6 treatments)

armGroups.label: Sham
armGroups.description: Sham TPE PROCEDURE once a month for 6 months (total of 6 treatments)

interventions.name: Sham
interventions.description: The patient's blood will not circulate through the apheresis machine. The patient will receive approximately 250 cc of normal saline during each sham pheresis procedure.

interventions.name: Therapeutic Plasma Exchange
interventions.description: Blood is withdrawn from a peripheral or central vein into the blood cell separator which separates the whole blood into plasma and cell components. The plasma is removed and the blood cells are returned to the patient along with replacement fluids, most commonly 5% human albumin in normal saline.

primaryOutcomes.measure: Adverse events and unanticipated events total for TPE safety
primaryOutcomes.description: The primary objective is to assure the safety of long term TPE
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 1 year

primaryOutcomes.measure: Rate of change to blood epigenetic clock from TPE
primaryOutcomes.description: The objective is to compare the rate of change to the blood epigenetic clock from TPE.
primaryOutcomes.timeFrame: through study completion, an average of 1 year

secondaryOutcomes.description: The objective is to compare changes in hand grip strength from TPE
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: after study completion, an average of 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in time up and go test
secondaryOutcomes.description: The objective is to compare changes in the time up and go test from TPE
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: after study completion, an average of 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.description: The objective is to compare changes in balance time from TPE
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: after study completion, an average of 2 years

secondaryOutcomes.measure: Change in short-form health survey score
secondaryOutcomes.description: The objective is to compare changes in short-form health survey scores from TPE, with higher scores being better
secondaryOutcomes.timeFrame: after study completion, an average of 2 years

eligibilityModule.eligibilityCriteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Subjects over 50 years of age with or without chronic inflammatory condition

Exclusion Criteria:

* Poor peripheral vascular access
* Diagnosis of active malignancy
* Late-stage Alzheimer's disease Any medical condition which may deteriorate because of plasma exchange procedures. These include, but are not limited to, symptomatic coronary artery disease, congestive heart failure and restrictive pulmonary disease (COPD). The investigators reserve the right to exclude anyone they feel may be harmed in any way by participating in the trial.
* Presence of active infection
* Alcohol or drug dependency
* Psychiatric disorder that will interfere with participation in the study (e.g., schizophrenia, bipolar disorder)
